indemnity.title: Indemnity
standard_examples: Each party agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the other party against any third-party claims arising solely out of a material breach of this Agreement or direct gross negligence.
The Employee shall indemnify the Company against direct damages resulting from intentional misconduct or unlawful acts committed during the course of employment.
Landlord and Tenant shall each maintain insurance and indemnify the other for direct physical loss or personal injury caused directly by their own negligent actions on the premises.

Provider agrees to indemnify Client against any final judgment awarded by a court of competent jurisdiction resulting from infringement of third-party intellectual property rights by Provider's deliverables.
one_sided_examples: Client shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Service Provider, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, costs, losses, damages, liabilities, and legal fees of any kind, whether direct, indirect, consequential, or incidental, regardless of fault or negligence of Service Provider.

Tenant agrees to indemnify Landlord for all claims, damages, losses, expenses, and attorney fees arising from any occurrence in or about the Leased Premises, regardless of cause or whether caused by Landlord's own negligence.

Employee agrees to unconditionally indemnify and hold harmless Company for any financial loss, loss of profit, or third-party claim brought against the Company relating in any way to Employee's employment or separation.
Borrower shall indemnify Lender against any loss, expense, fee, tax, fine, or liability incurred by Lender under any circumstances whatsoever related to this loan.

non_compete.title: Non-Compete / Restraint of Trade
standard_examples: During the term of employment and for a period of 6 months thereafter, Employee shall not directly solicit the active clients of the Company with whom Employee had direct business dealings in the preceding 12 months.
For 1 year following termination, Contractor agrees not to perform identical services for the specific key competitors of Client explicitly listed in Schedule A within the city of operation.
Employee agrees not to misuse or disclose confidential trade secrets or proprietary customer lists of the Employer following separation.
The Founder agrees for 12 months after departure not to recruit or solicit any current key executive of the Company.
one_sided_examples: Employee agrees that for a period of 3 years following termination for any reason, Employee shall not engage in, work for, consult with, invest in, or start any business operating in the technology or business sector anywhere in the country.

Contractor is perpetually restrained from engaging in any business activity or providing any services that compete directly or indirectly with any existing or future line of business of the Company worldwide.
Employee shall not, directly or indirectly, work for any client, prospective client, competitor, vendor, or partner of the Company for 24 months post-employment, without geographic limitation.
For a period of 5 years after separation, Employee shall not work in any capacity for any entity operating in the same industry across all jurisdictions.

dispute_resolution.title: Arbitration / Unilateral Forum Selection
standard_examples: Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the local Arbitration Association, with costs shared equally by both parties.
The parties agree that any legal action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the courts of mutual agreed jurisdiction, and both parties submit to such jurisdiction.
In the event of a dispute, parties agree to negotiate in good faith for 30 days prior to initiating formal litigation or mediation.
Arbitration proceedings shall be conducted by a single neutral arbitrator agreed upon by both parties, with the prevailing party entitled to reasonable legal fees.
one_sided_examples: Company reserves the exclusive right to choose whether any dispute shall be resolved through arbitration or court litigation in the jurisdiction of Company's sole choice, while Customer waives all rights to court litigation and must submit all claims to mandatory binding arbitration.

Any claim by Tenant against Landlord must be submitted to private arbitration selected exclusively by Landlord, while Landlord retains the unilateral right to sue Tenant in court for eviction or damages.
Employee waives all right to trial by jury or court proceedings, while Employer retains the right to seek injunctive relief in any court of its choice at Employee's expense.

Customer agrees that all disputes shall be litigated solely in the court located in Company's foreign headquarters, and Customer shall bear all court costs and legal fees incurred by Company regardless of outcome.

penalty.title: Penalty / Liquidated Damages
standard_examples: If Contractor fails to complete deliverables by the agreed deadline, Contractor shall pay as liquidated damages a sum equal to 0.5% of the phase fee per week of delay, capped at a maximum of 5% of total contract value.
Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of 1% per month or the maximum legal rate allowed, whichever is lower.
Tenant failure to pay rent within 5 days of due date shall incur a standard late administrative fee of $50.
If either party breaches the confidentiality obligations, the breaching party shall be liable for actual proven economic damages.
one_sided_examples: In the event Employee terminates employment prior to completing 24 months of service for any reason, Employee shall pay Company an immediate punitive penalty of $50,000 as reimbursement for training and onboarding costs without proof of actual cost.
Tenant agrees that any breach of any rule in this agreement shall result in immediate forfeiture of the entire security deposit plus a liquidated damage penalty equal to 6 months of rent.
If Client cancels service prior to contract end, Client shall immediately pay 100% of the remaining contract balance as liquidated damages, plus an additional 25% administrative penalty fee.
Borrower agrees that any payment delay exceeding 3 days shall trigger an immediate default penalty fee of 20% of the principal loan balance.

termination.title: Unilateral Termination
standard_examples: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause by giving thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.
This Agreement may be terminated by either party immediately upon written notice if the other party materially breaches any provision and fails to cure such breach within 15 days.
Landlord or Tenant may terminate the lease at the end of the term by providing 60 days advance written notice.
In the event of insolvency or bankruptcy of either party, the non-insolvent party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice.
one_sided_examples: Company may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, immediately without notice and without any further obligation, while Contractor cannot terminate this agreement prior to contract end without Company's written approval.

Landlord reserves the right to terminate this lease and evict Tenant upon 24 hours notice at Landlord's sole discretion, while Tenant remains bound for the full 3-year term without right of early termination.
Employer may terminate Employee's employment at any time without prior notice or severance pay, whereas Employee must provide 90 days prior written notice and pay a replacement fee.
Lender may accelerate the full loan balance and demand immediate payment in full at any time at Lender's sole discretion without notice or cause.

penal_interest.title: Penal / Default Interest
standard_examples: In the event of payment default, default interest shall accrue on the overdue installment at a rate of 2% per annum above the applicable interest rate until paid.
Overdue amounts shall bear simple interest at the rate of 1.5% per month starting 10 business days after the scheduled due date.
If Borrower fails to pay any scheduled monthly installment within a 15-day grace period, Lender may assess default interest of 2% per annum on the delinquent amount only.
Any overdue payment under this facility will be subject to a late interest charge of 18% per annum calculated strictly on the unpaid balance for the actual delay period.
one_sided_examples: Upon any payment delay exceeding 24 hours, compound penal interest of 36% per annum shall apply retroactively to the entire original principal loan amount.
Lender may levy default penal interest at 5% per month compounded weekly on the entire loan facility from the original date of disbursement upon any minor breach.
Failure to pay any charge on the exact due date will immediately subject the borrower to an arbitrary penal rate determined solely by Lender up to 50% compounded monthly.
Any administrative or technical payment delay shall entitle Lender to charge retroactive penal interest of 30% per annum on all historical advances regardless of cure.

acceleration.title: Acceleration of Loan
standard_examples: If Borrower fails to cure a payment default within 30 days of receiving written notice, Lender may declare the outstanding principal and accrued interest immediately due and payable.
Lender may accelerate maturity of the loan only upon an uncured material default, bankruptcy, or insolvency event following 21 days formal cure notice.
Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default and failure to cure within 14 business days, Lender may accelerate repayment of all remaining scheduled installments.
In case of repeated non-payment following written warning and a 30-day remedy period, Lender may call for immediate repayment of outstanding principal.
one_sided_examples: Lender may at its sole and unfettered discretion, without notice, cause, or cure period, declare the entire outstanding loan balance immediately due and payable in full.
Any subjective feeling of insecurity by Lender regarding Borrower financial condition shall entitle Lender to accelerate the entire facility with immediate 24-hour demand.
Upon any trivial technical non-compliance with any loan guideline, the total loan balance shall automatically accelerate without demand, presentment, or notice.
Lender reserves the unrestricted right to accelerate repayment in full at any time by issuing same-day written demand irrespective of payment history.

foreclosure_charges.title: Foreclosure / Prepayment Charges
standard_examples: Borrower may prepay the loan in whole or in part at any time without penalty or foreclosure fees upon 15 days written notice.
Prepayment of floating rate advances shall incur zero foreclosure charges in accordance with regulatory banking standards.
Borrower may prepay fixed-rate installments subject to a reasonable administrative cost recovery fee not exceeding 1% of the prepaid principal amount.
No prepayment premium or foreclosure fee shall be assessed if the facility is repaid using Borrower own legitimate financial savings.
one_sided_examples: Borrower is strictly prohibited from prepaying or foreclosing the loan prior to maturity without paying an exorbitant exit penalty of 15% of the total original sanctioned facility.
Any full or partial prepayment shall incur a mandatory foreclosure fee equal to 10% of the entire loan value plus all unearned future interest through the final loan term.
Lender reserves the unilateral right to refuse early closure, and if allowed, assess a minimum foreclosure fee of six months gross interest regardless of early payment date.
Early foreclosure for any reason requires payment of an unliquidated penalty of 12% of sanctioned limits regardless of whether floating or fixed interest applies.

unilateral_interest_change.title: Unilateral Interest Rate Change
standard_examples: Interest rates shall vary strictly in accordance with published changes in the Reserve Bank of India repo rate or external benchmark benchmarked transparently.
Any modification to the floating benchmark rate shall be notified to Borrower 30 days in advance with the option to prepay the loan without penalty if unaccepted.
The applicable interest rate shall be pegged to the standard Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) published quarterly by the banking regulator.
Changes to the margin spread shall require mutual written consent, while the benchmark rate shall adjust automatically to regulatory market movements.
one_sided_examples: Lender reserves the absolute right to increase the interest rate at any time at its sole discretion without prior notice, justification, or reference to any external index.
The interest rate may be revised upward unilaterally by Lender at any time, and Borrower shall have no right to object or exit the facility without penalty.
Lender may retroactively alter the spread margin and increase interest charges at will whenever Lender deems its internal cost of funds to have changed.
Borrower agrees that Lender can change the fixed or floating rate at any time without notice, and continued use of the facility constitutes irrevocable acceptance.

guarantor_liability.title: Guarantor Liability
standard_examples: The Guarantor liability shall be co-extensive with Borrower for the specific facility up to the maximum capped principal amount of 500,000.
Lender shall exhaust reasonable collection remedies against Borrower primary assets before initiating recovery demands against Guarantor personal assets.
The guarantee shall terminate automatically upon full repayment and discharge of the principal loan balance and issuance of a no-dues certificate.
Guarantor obligations shall be limited strictly to the actual outstanding balance and shall not extend to any future or separate credit facilities without fresh consent.
one_sided_examples: The Guarantor agrees to an unlimited, continuing, and irrevocable guarantee covering all present, past, and future indebtedness of Borrower and all its affiliates forever.
Guarantor waives all legal rights under contract law, including right to notice of variance, right of subrogation, and right to require Lender to proceed against Borrower first.
Lender may proceed directly against Guarantor personal home and assets immediately without making any demand or claim against Borrower.
Guarantor remains perpetually liable for any increased credit limits, new facilities, or extensions granted by Lender to Borrower without Guarantor knowledge or signature.

set_off_lien.title: Set-Off / Banker Lien
standard_examples: Lender may exercise a right of set-off against Borrower designated deposit accounts held with Lender strictly upon the occurrence of an uncured payment default.
Prior to exercising banker lien over Borrower accounts, Lender shall provide 14 business days advance written notice specifying the overdue amount.
Set-off rights shall apply solely to undisputed overdue amounts under this Agreement and shall not extend to third-party trust accounts or joint spousal accounts.
Lender agrees to release its lien over auxiliary deposit accounts once the overdue loan installment has been settled in full.
one_sided_examples: Lender shall have an immediate general lien and unrestricted right of set-off over all bank accounts, securities, salary deposits, and assets of Borrower and immediate family members at any time without notice.
Lender may debit any account of Borrower or Guarantor across any banking institution without notice or court order, whether or not a default has occurred.
Borrower grants Lender an absolute right to freeze and confiscate all personal and business funds across any affiliated entities immediately upon any suspected delay.
Lender may arbitrarily seize any assets, deposits, or receivables belonging to Borrower to satisfy any disputed or unaccrued future obligation at Lender convenience.

service_bond.title: Service Bond / Mandatory Lock-in
standard_examples: If Employee voluntarily resigns within 12 months after receiving specialized external certification funded by Company, Employee shall reimburse actual verifiable training fees on a prorated basis.
Employee agrees that documented third-party training expenses exceeding 50,000 incurred in the prior 6 months shall be reimbursed prorata upon early departure.
Any training cost reimbursement shall be capped strictly at actual direct tuition receipts paid by Employer, reducing by one-twelfth for each completed month of service.
Company may recover only verifiable out-of-pocket training fees if Employee resigns within 6 months of specialized skill training.
one_sided_examples: Employee must execute a mandatory 3-year service bond and agrees that leaving for any reason prior to 36 months requires an immediate forfeiture of 1,000,000 as liquidated damages without proof of training cost.
Employee agrees to a strict 2-year lock-in period and surrenders original academic degree certificates to Employer until completion of the service bond.
Any resignation before completing the 24-month mandatory lock-in period shall obligate Employee to pay two full years of gross salary as a punitive departure penalty.
Employee agrees not to resign under any circumstances for 3 years, and any attempt to terminate employment shall incur an unnegotiable penalty of 500,000 plus attorney fees.

ip_assignment.title: IP Assignment / Invention Ownership
standard_examples: Employee assigns to Employer all intellectual property and inventions conceived or developed during working hours directly relating to the Company business.
All proprietary software created by Employee specifically using Company equipment and resources for Company projects shall belong exclusively to Company.
Inventions created by Employee during the term of employment within the scope of assigned duties shall be the sole property of Employer.
Employee retains full rights and ownership over pre-existing intellectual property and personal inventions created entirely on personal time without Company confidential data.
one_sided_examples: Employee irrevocably assigns to Company all inventions, ideas, concepts, patents, writings, and creations developed at any time in life, including outside work hours, on personal devices, or after termination.
Company shall own all intellectual property created by Employee forever, including unrelated hobbies, personal projects, and works created prior to joining Company.
Employee waives all moral rights and assigns all future creative output developed during the 5 years following separation from Company in any field of endeavor.
Any invention conceived by Employee or family members during the employment term shall automatically vest in Employer without compensation or attribution.

notice_period_garden_leave.title: Notice Period / Garden Leave Imbalance
standard_examples: Either party may terminate the employment by providing 30 days prior written notice or basic salary in lieu of notice.
Company may place Employee on paid garden leave during the contractual 30-day notice period while maintaining full salary and contractual benefits.
Both Employer and Employee agree to a reciprocal 60-day notice period, with option for mutual waiver in writing upon agreement.
During any garden leave period not exceeding 30 days, Employee shall continue to receive full remuneration and employment perks.
one_sided_examples: Employer may terminate Employee instantly with zero notice or severance, whereas Employee is bound to serve a mandatory 180-day notice period and pay 6 months salary if requesting early release.
Company reserves the right to place Employee on unpaid garden leave for up to 12 months at Company sole discretion while prohibiting Employee from working elsewhere.
Employee must provide 90 days notice to resign, during which Company may unilaterally suspend pay, withhold incentives, and enforce restrictive covenant extensions.
Employer may dismiss Employee with 24 hours notice without pay, while Employee must give 6 months advance notice and obtain written board approval to separate.
